items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: he was married to Pat Dane, who is a showgirl, and we used to play cards and everybody was happy.

ctx.x: What was it like to work for Dorsey? Was he a pretty demanding leader? A nice guy?

Well he was very demanding before I got there. From what I understood he was on all kinds of things like terpin hydrate and codeine, which was anything to get him high I’m certain. I don’t know truthfully what that does to you but he had been on that, which was bad. But when we got there, Gussie and I, he was calm, he was off all that stuff, very nice, he was married to Pat Dane, who is a showgirl, and we used to play cards and everybody was happy. It was one of the happiest times of my life. There I was with a…
Well you got out here, and gee, things have changed dramatically.
